assumptions: the core of (D; Γ) is automorphism-transitive
attrs.evidence: ⋂U_Γ is pp-definable, contains B, and is End-invariant, so it contains every h(B); conversely it is contained in the member End(A)·b. Checked by requiring every bounded realized projection to contain the computed hull, on every language of the §4b table where the property holds.
attrs.statement: When Γ has a transitive core B, the intersection of all non-empty unary pp-definable relations of Γ equals End(A)·b for any b in B — the endomorphic hull of the core.
